doc.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Collective decisions in Sphere
summary: The business side was collective, not Barron alone; it is hard on managers.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Good foresight, good business management, good plan. Was that you? Were you the main . . . ?

It was all collective. It wasn’t me. It was everybody, Buster, Ben, and Charlie. I think there should be more things like that happening. For managers, though, it’s a disaster, because instead of contacting one person, they have to contact four people with the same information.
